meaning: Observe original generated Workflow materialization and forward Operation call incidence, argument and return identities, and the unchanged independent Workflow execution semantics.
expected_source: Checked Workflow binding, independent Workflow value, execution, settlement and outcome references plus every existing finite Workflow case, through the explicitly selected compact successor. No generated body or native observation supplies expected answers.

calls.operation: Original forward Operation wrapper, awaited once per reached source occurrence with the exact original materialized argument object and the captured dependency object for that Operation selector.
calls.order: Capture once after identity validation; for each reached source occurrence arguments then awaited Operation; only committed results are captured. Final result follows all captured results. Recovery preparation follows only the independently selected recovery plan.
calls.failure: Invalid identities have no material calls; failed material calls record TypeError kind and stop the applicable phase. Error prose is not the protocol identity. Operation uncertainty and failure continuation remain the existing contract.
calls.identity: Per-case source input and captured per-selector dependencies have handles. Every object returned by an observed original call, plus an object-valued original Operation result, has an occurrence-qualified handle. Subsequent arguments must reference those exact objects, not structural copies. The native observer must retain object ownership across cases to reject reused returns.
calls.data: Successful result data is SHA-256 over canonical tagged inert values, separately from identity handles. Deep-frozen status is required for returned object graphs. Primitive values remain tagged values; no object identity is asserted for scalars.
calls.arguments: Record exact arity and tagged arguments before calls; captured result prefix entries retain their individual handles and source order. No getters are read for raw source-input handles.

coverage: Only selected direct generated-runtime imports from the Workflow provider are direct-protocol obligations; type-only, wrapper identity, Operation internals and other transitive dependencies remain separately accounted. Selected controls are not native proof.
execution_lane: Strict ES2022 NodeNext ESM. Future native import facades must call original unchanged module exports and return their actual objects in the same realm. Audits and retained execution remain mandatory independent facets.

limits.unavailable: Whole family not_evaluable, never truncate to a passing prefix.
limits.batch_identity: Original modules and identity maps persist across all batches; require every case exactly once in source order.

claim_ceiling: Independent expectations and case controls do not establish native interoperability, retained execution, public integration, runtime admission or full CLI completion.
semantic_encoding: semantic_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON of the complete unchanged semantic observation, including all outcomes, effects, waits, identities and mutation checks. No semantic field or case is omitted. Comparison relies on SHA-256 collision resistance.
